verdict.rationale: Kit documents two credential types, OAuth 2.0 for App Store apps and API keys for your own account, plus read-only analytics endpoints. Nothing in the pack shows that either credential can be scoped or restricted to read-only, so no documented credential type withholds the power to send broadcasts. The Kit MCP is described as read-and-write account access, which is the opposite of the restriction this story asks for.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can mint scoped or read-only API credentials so an agent or contractor can read analytics without the power to send
